name: Hencamp Creek
description:
SUNDAY 27th SEPTEMBER

REGISTRATION WITH THE WALK LEADER IS ESSENTIAL. PLEASE READ THE INFORMATION BELOW.

RATED: Hard

DESCRIPTION
Hencamp will be a full day, creek based (no track) hike. The terrain will be rough with rockhopping, boulder scrambles, rockface traverses, some scrub bashing (maybe with a steep hill), uneven footing and potentially slippery rocks. The reward though is a scenic creek with cascades and a gorge.

FITNESS
You will need to be a fit and capable walker who can maintain a steady pace all day and is capable of using their upper and lower body to climb up/down rocks etc.

WHAT TO BRING
- Water: you will need water for full day eg minimum 3L 
- Clothing: there is a lot of long grass and scrub so full long sleeve clothing is recommended. Many members also wear fingerless gloves.
- Enclosed footwear
- Food for the day
- Hat, sunscreen and insect repellent
- Usual bushwalking gear 
- Personal first aid kit including a compression bandage and blister kit is recommended.

COST
Non members = $5 walk fee for insurance
Must be over 18years to participate

WALK LEADER, INFO and REGISTRATION
Walk leader is Keith.
To discuss suitability, to register or for more information please contact tsvbush@hotmail.com and we will get back to you asap. 

WALK DETAILS
Meet time: 8am near Rollingtstone
Return time: back at cars approx. 5pm

name: Crystal Creek Falls (bottom) - pls read event description
description:
REGISTRATION WITH THE WALK LEADER IS ESSENTIAL.

SUMMARY: This will be a full day walk involving some on-track walking, off-track bush bashing, boulder hopping and steep declines/inclines. We will explore Stinky Creek and further down Crystal Creek below the falls.
Expect jungle, vines, wait-awhile, a few boulders (there is a challenging boulder scramble near the bottom). At the bottom, we can admire the view of the bottom tier of Crystal Creek Falls (which you cannot see from the top), explore a bit and then we will try to get further downstream. This is largely the unknown exploratory bit, and may be very hard.

RATING: Hard 

WHAT TO BRING:
- Food and drink for the day
- Closed in footwear
- Long sleeve clothing recommended
- Hat, sunscreen + insect repellent
- First Aid kit including snake bite and blister kits

name: Crystal Creek Falls (top)
description:
REGISTRATION WITH THE WALK LEADER IS ESSENTIAL

WHEN: Saturday 19th  – Full day

WALK SUMMARY:  this is one of our easier walks suitable for those new to bushwalking, or just wanting an easier day. You still need reasonable bushwalking fitness especially for the walk back to the Dam carpark which is the hardest part. It is still a great bushwalk with good highlights.  

This walk will be a rainforest track walk from Paluma dam to Crystal Creek falls (top) via Rock Garden.  Whilst a track walk, it is a rough rainforest track with tree roots, uneven footing, and rocks at times, and a few steep bits. The reward is a wonderful rainforest walk, a lookout, the rock garden, and the superb Crystal Creek Falls top section.  And a great swimming hole, one of the best. We may even bush bash a short way up to Blue Lagoon.  

Note that the walk from the waterfall back to the dam is the hardest part, uphill slog for 1.5 hrs (about 5 km), ascending over 200 mr (it feels like more than 200 mr ascent though). And the track is rough and uneven in several places. 

You will also learn about the extensive marked track system in Paluma / Mt Spec region (over 100 km of marked walking tracks), the track markers, and other good info on track walks in the area

WHEN:
Saturday 19th September
Meet: 8:45 am for 9:00am departure at Paluma Dam
Return: by 4pm to allow time to drive down the range before the Paluma Rd closes for roadworks at 6pm

WHAT TO BRING:
- Enclosed footwear suitable for bush tracks
- Daypack with food / snacks for the day
- 2 lt water (refill from creek if required, but treat / filter your refill, or carry more water)
- Personal first aid kit
- Insect repellent
- Sun protection: hat, sunscreen, long clothing
- Electrolytes (optional but recommenced - use a brand that you are familiar with and sits well in your tummy)
- Hiking pole can be handy for some

COST
 Non members = $5 walk fee for insurance
 Must be over 18years to participate
